name: Lesson 26 · Fresh bread, good morning: adjective endings with no article

cards.note: Adjective endings without an article (strong). With no article, the adjective takes the article's ending itself: das → -es. lecker after ist has none.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Tee → heißer: the -r of der.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Milch → kalte: the -e of die.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Kuchen → süßer.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Reis → weißer.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Wein → italienischer. Adjectives of nationality are written small.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). Plural with no article: -e, like die.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). Greetings are wishes in the accusative: der Morgen → guten.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Abend → guten Abend.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Tag → guten Tag: the everyday hello.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Nacht → gute.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). das Wochenende → schönes.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Glückwunsch → herzlichen, accusative like guten Morgen.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Käse as the object: -en.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Saft → frischen in the accusative.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). es gibt takes the accusative: frischen Fisch.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). Ordering, the accusative is understood: (ich möchte) schwarzen Kaffee.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Butter → frische.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Suppe → scharfe.

cards.front: In the evening I eat **warm** soup.
cards.note: Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Suppe → warme.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). das Bier → kaltes.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). das Brot → italienisches.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). Plural object with no article: -e.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). A number is not an article, so the adjective takes the strong -e.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). zwei is no article: kleine.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Nudeln (plural) → leckere.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). mit + dative, die Butter → frischer: the -r of der.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Milch in the dative: kalter.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). der Käse in the dative: -em, like dem.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). das Wasser in the dative: heißem.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). die Wurst in the dative: scharfer.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). Dative plural: -en, like den.
Adjective endings without an article (strong). The end of a formal letter: mit + dative plural, freundlichen Grüßen.
